cameraListIndex.description: Index of the camera in the DCAM-enumerated list (0-based), or any string to force the mock fallback. Shipped setups use both; nothing narrower is accepted.

hamamatsu.description: Dictionary of DCAM API property name → value pairs applied via ``setPropertyValue`` at startup.

mockSample.description: Simulation only (mock camera on a simulated NI-DAQ): the frames show the synthetic sample (cells and beads) under a square MoNaLISA foci lattice fixed on the camera, the sample moved by the stage position the scan waveforms give at each camera trigger. ``{"axes": {"<x device>": <µm per V>, "<y device>": <µm per V>}, "latticePeriodUm": 0.72, "seed": 0}``; each axis carries its positioner's ``conversionFactor``. Without it the mock frames are uniform noise.
